title: Kth Smallest Product of Two Sorted Arrays
goal: Find the kth smallest pair product from two sorted signed arrays.
strategy: Binary search the answer value. For each first-array value, binary-search how many second-array products are at most the threshold; negative multipliers reverse the monotone direction.
